$description: QAFlywheel scenarios for the on-device iOS agent (Phase AV.17, 2026-11-10): what a person might say to the general Agent in the chat, each with deterministic checks scored on the Mac by mchatai_macOS/LocalLLM/scripts/agent_flywheel.py. Run on the iPad through the agent-evals harness; writes are sandboxed. Not loaded by the AIWizard flywheel (its loaders list their catalogs by name).

$runPolicy.checks: expect = steps that must succeed; forbid = steps that must not run; forbidSources = sources the found list must not come from; noTools = no step at all; mustSay / mustNotSay = case-insensitive patterns on the reply; wants = the step a future verb should take (reported, not scored); every reply is also checked for claiming an action no step did.
